# Portfolio Decision Record Template

Status: reusable template

Use this only for a real engineering decision or a clearly labeled retrospective comparison. Do not create a decision record just to display architecture vocabulary.

## 12. Resume / PDF / Web Use

- **Resume:** usually omit unless the decision materially differentiates the candidate.
- **PDF:** use as a compact trade-off matrix when visually useful.
- **Web:** link from the relevant case-study deep dive.
- **Interview:** use to explain judgment, constraints, and accepted downside.

## Review Gate

- [ ] the decision was real or explicitly labeled retrospective
- [ ] constraints are project-specific, not generic
- [ ] alternatives are not invented
- [ ] personal participation in the decision is confirmed
- [ ] verification is described
- [ ] no confidential detail is exposed
